items.title: Bill Allred interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: I never played with so many hotshot musicians in my life as the old Norway ship jazz parties with Hank and Shelly used to book the musicians.

ctx.x: Wycliffe. So there are those. And I remember I was with Wild Bill Davison’s, I mean I never played with so many hotshot musicians in my life as the old Norway ship jazz parties with Hank and Shelly used to book the musicians.
